company.name: Nubank
company.description: Nubank is a digital-first bank that grew from a challenger credit-card provider into a large digital bank serving consumers across Latin America (E3). The company emphasizes branchless, mobile onboarding and a customer-centric model that decouples activities in the traditional banking value chain (E4, E8). Nubank offers digital account opening, real-time no-fee transactions, AI-enabled customer service, and consumer credit products with simplified pricing and transparency (E8, E9, E10, E11).

customers.primary_user: retail consumers / individual account holders (digital-first customers)
segments: mass-market retail consumers in Latin America (digital-first)
customers seeking low-friction, mobile-first banking products

business_model.value_proposition: Digital-first, customer-centric banking that simplifies onboarding, offers real-time no-fee transactions, transparent credit products, and 24/7 AI-enabled customer service by decoupling traditionally bundled banking activities (E4, E8, E9, E10, E11).
cost_drivers: technology and platform infrastructure to support mobile onboarding and real-time transactions (E8, E9)

incumbents: traditional banks (bundled branch-based incumbents with higher friction) (E6)
direct_competitors: other neobanks / fintech challengers (digital banks addressing similar pain points) (E4)
